propositions: Empty file_impact is overloaded to mean both 'author forgot' and 'no repo file touched', so a third explicit state is added to the data model.
The FILE_IMPACT event payload gains optional file_impact_scope and no_file_impact_reason keys, with reducer state deriving scope as paths/none/undeclared via a pure helper in process_file_impact.
The set-file-impact CLI command moves from the fixed-arity _REGISTRY to the variadic _ARGV_REGISTRY and accepts a new '--none <reason>' form alongside the unchanged JSON-array form.
Exactly one of the two CLI forms must be supplied; both, neither, or --none without a value is a usage error exiting 2, and the reason requires at least 10 non-whitespace characters.
A new library function get_file_impact_scope returns kind/reason/paths, and declare_no_file_impact writes the same state as the CLI; rebar show surfaces the two new keys.
A dedicated MCP write tool declare_no_file_impact returns a string ack with no outputSchema, applies the same reason validation, and rejects short reasons without writing an event.
